approvers: Developer / main contractor, site manager, glazing subcontractor
reason: Glazing protection is set in the subcontract package and the developer or main contractor decides who pays, so I can't just add a new supplier line. I've never seen this used in Malta, and tape and film already do the job cheaply enough.
objection: Never seen it on a Maltese job, and at about 19 euro/m2 it costs many times what film or tape does. I'd also be carrying the risk if it damages seals or leaves residue.
instead: Keep specifying standard protection film and tape, with the glazing subcontractor carrying the damage risk under the subcontract.
would_change_my_mind: A reference local job on a Maltese apartment block with a developer or main contractor naming it in the spec, plus insurance cover and a manufacturer guarantee on frame finishes.
